title: Zivai (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A Tanna. Berakhot 53b: the rabbis taught, “Oil is indispensable to the blessing,” according to Rabbi Zilai. Rabbi Zivai says it is not indispensable; Rabbi Acha says fine oil is indispensable. Hyman places Rabbi Acha in Rabbi's time, as explained in his entry.

notes.text: The source prints מעבב where the context requires מעכב, “is indispensable.” Its letters are retained in the frozen source. Zilai, Zivai and Acha remain distinct disputants.
The consulted Berakhot passage has Rav Acha where Hyman has Rabbi Acha. Hyman’s statement about Acha’s period is a separate inference.
